name: code_distill_user
content: Distill durable, reusable codebase knowledge from the following coding-session episodes.

1. Extract only DURABLE code facts that help a FUTURE coding run in the same codebase: locations, conventions/patterns, build/test/run commands, architecture & boundaries, decisions + rationale, and failures (what was tried, why it broke, the fix).
2. Skip transient run details, ephemeral IDs, and anything not reusable.
3. Never emit secrets, credentials, tokens, or personal data.
4. When an episode names the project/repo, prefix the `key` with it (`<project>:<area>:<topic>`); the key is the dedup identity, so reuse the same key when refining an existing fact.
5. Deduplicate overlapping facts into a single most-specific item.
6. Conform each item to the target tier schema above (emit `key` and `value`; omit `last_seen`).
Return ONLY a valid JSON array of {key, value} objects. No markdown, no code blocks, no prose. If nothing durable is present, return [].

variables.name: source_json
variables.description: JSON-serialized coding-session episodes to distill code knowledge from.
examples: [{"summary": "Implemented auth middleware in src/auth/middleware.rs using thiserror"}]

variables.name: tier_schema
variables.description: JSON schema of the target code-knowledge tier (key/value/last_seen item shape).

variables.name: episode_count
variables.description: Number of coding-session episodes provided as source.

metadata.description: User prompt instructing the LLM to distill coding-session episodes into durable {key, value} code-knowledge facts conforming to the target tier schema.
